conflict_rule: JSON is normative; stop before production load/action if code, prose, sources or operation counts conflict. Amend/version/commit before any science; never silently change after evaluation.

research_questions.RQ1: Can response correction reduce CISD state bias while preserving exact eigenstate target?
research_questions.RQ2: Does refitting the same fixed model reduce total finite-time prediction error?
research_questions.RQ3: Is the response tradeoff distinct from equal-information Ritz state improvement?
research_questions.RQ4: Which of absolute error, magnitude underestimation and sign crossings improve?

scope.evaluation_type: Previously observed development data; algorithm/predictions frozen before scoring, not prospective or independent holdout.

observable.signed_policy: Build +t and -t independently. Direct saved branches joined independently by sign. No echo argument/unwrap fit or averaging switch.

response.implementation_span: MGS Arnoldi on L with residual start; equivalent prefix span to requested powers
response.solution: z=Z_m c, minimum-norm truncated thin-SVD solution of B=LZ_m
response.projected_quantities: Save L_m=Z†B and a_m=Z†a as diagnostics, never substitute them for full-residual objective.
response.target_invariance: X=z psi†-psi z†, Atilde=A-[H,X]; every exact H-eigenstate has unchanged expectation for fixed X.

numeric.orthogonalization: Exactly two modified Gram-Schmidt passes; project against psi before each pass, then sequential accepted columns. Largest-magnitude component phase made positive, first index wins ties.
numeric.initial_rank_threshold: 64 eps N max(||Hpsi||,|E|,tiny); reject norm <= threshold
numeric.rank_stop: Stop at first rejected direction, use identical retained prefix for all arms/m; no replacement directions or increased m. k_m=min(m,k_max).
numeric.orthogonality_gate: ||Z†Z-I||_F and ||psi†Z||_2 <=64 eps N; failure stops, no extra passes.
numeric.SVD: Thin SVD of full B=N x k. Keep sigma_i >64 eps max(N,k) sigma_max. No ridge, inverse, gap truth, parameter search. Cache one factor per distinct nonzero k_m.
numeric.relative_residual_denominator: max(||a||,epsilon_num), epsilon_num=64 eps N max(||a||,1 Ha); fixed units Ha.
numeric.projected_hermiticity_gate: ||H_m-H_m†||_F <=64 eps N max(||H_m||_F,tiny); symmetrize only within this gate.
numeric.ritz_tie_rule: lowest projected eigenspace within 64 eps dim(H_m)||H_m||_2; project e0 then e1,... until norm>64 eps dim(H_m), normalize, fix largest-component phase.
numeric.nonfinite_policy: Stop affected run before interpretation on any nonfinite coefficient, vector, residual or proxy. Zero-rank response is z=0 and Ritz original psi, reuse baseline.
numeric.residual_convergence: For each of 22 signed coordinates and consecutive m, d_next<=d_prev+eta_prev+eta_next, eta_m=64 eps N(||a||+||B_m||_F||c_m||). All comparisons must pass for Outcome A. Cutoff changes may break monotonicity; record failure, never tune cutoff.
numeric.noise_rule: eta=max(||U†U-I||_F/|t|, |g_full_replay-g_first|,50 eps max(||H||_2,1/|t|)); same formula per arm, no truth in eta. Response conditioning/roundoff diagnostics separately reported, not a bias certificate.
numeric.rho_quality: rho=abs(g)/max(eta,1e-300); resolved>=100, marginal>=10, unresolved otherwise; applies to each arm. No post-hoc rescue.
numeric.cold_replay: One complete independent replay: rebuild basis, PF block/echo backend, states, factors, all signed proxies; no cache shared across passes. Local identical S2 block cache inside one build retained. Count all repeat operations.

ritz.solve: lowest small projected Hermitian eigenpair, dimension<=9; no full-H ground solve
ritz.proxy: Im <phi_m|W|phi_m>/t using forward W only, no adjoint needed for scalar expectation

arms.A3: saved exact-ground proxy; Phase B only, no new exact-state PF action
arms.diagnostics: response and Ritz m1,m2,m4; never select m after result

fit.scaling: each design column divided by its 2-norm, coefficients transformed back
fit.primary: raw_positive_even_two_term: five positive-time proxies; evaluate both signs with same even model
fit.validity: all five positive training rows marginal/resolved, at least three resolved, scaled condition<=1e8; fit_ok else not_identifiable. Same rule for all arms and diagnostics.

phase_boundary.phase_a_allowed: Whitelisted H,13 groups,CISD, fixed coefficients/times, epsilon/beta, normative parameters. No exact state/energy,D4/D6/D8, branch/direct/decomposition/whole truth-mixed CSV inputs.
phase_boundary.phase_a_freeze: Commit scalar proxy rows, fitted coefficients, all signed predictions, diagnostics, action ledger, source/code/protocol hashes. Manifest excludes itself; obtain full40 Git commit. Keep production vectors/matrices private and uncommitted.
phase_boundary.phase_b_precondition: Verify actual committed prediction blob equals frozen file bytes and SHA256 before invoking truth loader; reject changed/uncommitted bytes or source hash mismatch.
phase_boundary.phase_b_truth: Existing Phase B direct truth and exact-proxy scalars only, filter B/H4/current_m3/mechanism_fixed and exact 12 signed evaluation keys; exact training scalars only for A3 reference fits. No new direct/Schur/ground computation.
phase_boundary.failure_policy: Missing/duplicate/unreliable branch or hash mismatch stops scoring. No replacement, interpolation, coordinate addition or prediction modification.
phase_boundary.production_runner: phase05_runner.py --phase-a / --phase-b fail closed before archive decode in this Phase0.5 package.

metrics.sign_crossing: nonadditive label; no componentwise unsafe attribution on crossing rows
metrics.zero_sign: numpy sign: zero is a distinct sign, no data-dependent zero threshold
metrics.point_improvement: sum(abs(g_response-g_exact)) lower than baseline over all 12 signed evaluation rows; diagnostic only
metrics.quality_policy: Retain all rows and raw fits including not_identifiable with status flags; no denominator filtering. Invalid primary fit/unstable run cannot support A or B.

outcomes.comparison: Strict continuous scalar decreases, no new percentage/material threshold. Report raw values, ratios (null if denominator zero), and all rowwise results.
outcomes.response_unique_tradeoff: Response is not Pareto-dominated by Ritz in tuple and strictly better in at least one component. Equal tuple does not qualify. Report any disadvantage explicitly; no sum of unlike action units.
outcomes.A: All: response S_abs<base, S_under<base, residual_converged, response_unique_tradeoff, stable/identifiable.
outcomes.B: Response and Ritz each reduce S_abs and S_under vs base; response lacks unique tradeoff; stable/identifiable.
outcomes.C: Response point/proxy aggregate improves but response does not reduce both total S_abs and S_under; no resource stage.
outcomes.D: Neither response nor Ritz reduces both S_abs and S_under, or numerical instability; no percentage threshold.
outcomes.uncovered_combinations: inconclusive_mixed_predicates is a reporting status for asymmetric or nonconverged combinations; do not force success/failure or modify A-D. GPT/user review required before follow-up.

paper_levels.2: response-specific tradeoff supported only after A; novel positioning still requires review
paper_levels.3: N2/CO resource improvement separately preregistered/authorized later; no current evidence.

backend_future_contract.implementation: CPU numpy1.26.4, scipy1.14.1 expm scaling/Padé, complex128; use original S2-cache block order and left multiplications; no full-H/group eigendecomposition or Schur.
backend_future_contract.block_rule: For each distinct S2 weight, build group0..11 half weights, group12 full, group11..0 half; left multiply; sequence seven blocks left multiplied. Four unique weights. Independent signed builds.
backend_future_contract.echo_actions: forward psi -> U psi -> exp(-iHt) U psi; adjoint psi -> exp(+iHt) psi -> U† exp(+iHt) psi. Use adjoints of the same signed matrices, not opposite-time echo.
backend_future_contract.exact_H_propagation: Explicitly costed classical echo reference; not an operational quantum access/free oracle assumption.
backend_future_contract.acceptance_before_science: Production adapter code review/test against synthetic original spectral builder and counter plan, no H4 tests/loader invocation until separate science authorization. No protocol changes to fit results.

cost_contract: expected_action_counts.json and cost_accounting.md; nominal rank8, two complete passes, exact lower counts recorded on prefix breakdown; diagnostic and primary cost reported separately.
